source_text: The World Health Organization (WHO) and Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC) have shaped narratives in sub-Saharan Africa through voluntary medical male circumcision (VMMC) programs aimed at HIV prevention, where hygiene benefits are emphasized alongside reduced infection risk, implicitly linking the circumcised form to a more sanitary aesthetic in public health visuals. [59]
